title: Classify a project's platform (web, server or shared) for the platform firewall
description: Set a project's one `platform:` tag — what the ESLint platform firewall keys on. With --platform it states it; without, it infers it from the project's evidence (the stack that builds it, its imports of packages bound to one platform, the platforms of the workspace projects it imports) and says why, refusing — with the evidence — when the project mixes web and server code.

platform.description: Where the project's code runs: `web` (browser/SSR — may depend on web and shared projects), `server` (Cloud Functions/Node — server and shared), `shared` (isomorphic — shared only, and imports no package bound to one platform). Omit to infer it from the project's imports.
